svg.title: FIG-11 Separate software, fixture and physical qualification Every conclusion binds source / config / artifact / execution scope
svg.desc: Clean source / dependency / toolchain / config Identical ELF / BIN / map bytes; Host / model Actual GoogleTest/GoogleMock + tool tests Software evidence for algorithms and failure paths; ARM compile / link / resources Actual instructions, ABI, layout and budgets; Independent Source SDK consumer Relocated prefix, actual build/run or link; Two independent network-disabled clean builds Same ELF/BIN bytes, original commands and tool identities; HIL fixture / station / protocol tooling Software checks for boundaries and negative paths; Scope proof + candidate seal Unsigned software candidate retaining original evidence; Actual station: PCB / silicon / probes / wires Flash the same image, then measure and inject faults; Record physical results only for actually executed cases Without equipment: not_executed; Product admission under actual software + physical scope Release / safety certification decided by external policy; Actual execution; Actual execution; Actual execution; Actual execution; Actual execution; Verify evidence; Verify evidence; Verify evidence; Verify evidence; Fixture scope, not physical measurement; Same image supplied to actual equipment; Only actual station results; Software scope; Independent review of physical scope
